Furnace Fabrica India Ltd.desc: An Indian engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contractor, registered in Kochi, Kerala and operating from Navi Mumbai. It reported turnover of Rs 235.96 crore in 2020-21; by March 2024 it was described as non-operational and in insolvency, the NCLT Kochi bench having admitted a State Bank of India petition over a default of Rs 64.74 crore on 1 November 2023.

Furnace Fabrica India Ltd.note: The EOI gives the EPC description, the Kochi registered office, the Navi Mumbai operations, the FY2020-21 turnover and the non-operational status; the NCLT order gives the admission date and default amount. No source I opened says the company's shares are listed, so none is claimed, and no incorporation year is claimed (only the CIN implies 1985/Kerala).

Italian-Thai Development Public Company.desc: A Thai construction contractor, described by Thai press as the country's largest construction company, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand under the ticker ITD. Its revenue from construction contracts was 56.93 billion baht in 2023, a year in which it reported a net loss of 1.07 billion baht.

sources.title: ITD reports billion baht loss but is confident it can make a comeback
ITD Reports 60% Decline in Profit as Costs and Allowance for Impairment Loss Increase

Italian-Thai Development Public Company.note: The company's own site (itd.co.th) and the Stock Exchange of Thailand's quote pages are both blocked to automated fetching (robots / bot protection), so the listing and figures come from Thai financial press instead. Kaohoon gives the listing as 'Italian-Thai Development Public Company Limited (SET: ITD)' and says results were announced through the Stock Exchange of Thailand. No founding year is claimed, as neither page states one.

MIN Holding (Masinska industrija Nis).desc: A machine-industry enterprise in Nis, southern Serbia, registered as d.o.o. Masinska industrija Nis Holding (a limited liability company). It has been in bankruptcy since 2015, and its bankruptcy estate has been selling off buildings in the MIN industrial complex in Nis at public auction, including sales in 2020 and 2024.

Masinska industrija Nis holding prodata za 10,1 miliona dinara

MIN Holding (Masinska industrija Nis).note: Kurir (May 2024) gives the legal name 'Doo Masinska industrija Nis Holding' and 'u stecaju od 2015. godine' (in bankruptcy since 2015), and describes the 2024 auction of a building in the MIN complex; Danas (Feb 2020) reports the earlier auction of MIN Holding's premises, halls and warehouses. Neither source says what the company manufactured, how many people it employed, or who owns it, so none of that is claimed. Deliberately NOT used: two 2011-12 Privatisation Agency bankruptcy notices for differently named Nis entities, 'MIN HOLDING CO ... IZGRADNJA AD' and 'MIN HOLDING-CO ... MINKOMERC AD' - both joint-stock companies in bankruptcy from 2011, i.e. not the d.o.o. the card names. The only source found for the wider MIN group's history and products was Wikipedia, which COMP.md bars as a sole source.

Metro Linea 1 S.A.S (ML1).desc: A Colombian concession company set up by the consortium that won the tender for the first Bogota metro line, holding concession contract 163 of 2019 with Empresa Metro de Bogota, signed on 27 November 2019. The city says it is owned by China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (85%) and Xi'an Rail Transportation Group Company Limited (15%); the contract covers 7.6 years for design and construction and 20 years of operation and maintenance, against an estimated investment of 13.83 trillion Colombian pesos.

sources.title: Los recursos de la Linea 1 estan en auditoria constante: Concesionario Metro Linea 1
ABC del concesionario de la Primera Linea del Metro de Bogota

Metro Linea 1 S.A.S (ML1).note: The 2019 management report calls it an 'empresa concesionaria constituida por el APCA ganadora para la ejecucion del contrato' - a concession company formed by the winning consortium - and gives the 27 November 2019 signing date; it names CHEC and Xi'an without percentages. The percentages come from the Metro company's ABC sheet (which names the 15% holder as 'Xi'an Metro Company Limited') and from the 2023 city page (which names it as 'Xi'an Rail Transportation Group Company Limited'). No source I opened calls it a special-purpose vehicle in those words, and none gives a registration date or a headquarters address, so none is claimed.

Ramky Infrastructure Ltd.desc: An Indian construction and infrastructure company incorporated in 1994 and based in Hyderabad, Telangana, listed on both BSE and the National Stock Exchange of India. It does engineering, procurement, construction and operations and maintenance work on infrastructure projects, mainly buildings, industrial, and water and waste water schemes, and had 1,041 permanent employees at the end of the 2025-26 financial year.

Ramky Infrastructure Ltd.note: The BRSR gives two different turnover figures for FY2025-26 (Rs 1,969.36 crore in the CSR section and Rs 1,678.93 crore as revenue from operations in the energy note) and does not reconcile them, so the employee count is used as the single plain figure instead.

Simplex Infrastructures Ltd.desc: An Indian engineering and construction company based in Kolkata, listed on BSE and the National Stock Exchange of India, which describes itself as a diversified engineering and construction enterprise with a legacy dating back to 1924. Standalone revenue from operations was 6,702 million rupees in the year to 31 March 2026, with 561 permanent employees on that date; it signed a master restructuring agreement with the National Asset Reconstruction Company on 15 January 2025 covering most of its debt.

sources.title: Annual Report 2025-26, Simplex Infrastructures Limited
sources.publisher: National Stock Exchange of India (company filing)

Simplex Infrastructures Ltd.note: The report states no NCLT application has been admitted and no insolvency proceedings were pending as at 31 March 2026. Consolidated revenue was 10,212 million rupees; the standalone figure is quoted to match the listed entity.

discrepancies.card_says: "Its owners are not named in any document I opened, so no headquarters is given here."
discrepancies.source_says: Bogota's own city website (September 2023) names the owners: "Metro Linea 1 S.A.S. es una sociedad comercial de la que son accionistas China Harbour Engineering Company Limited (85%) y XI'AN Rail Transportation Group Company Limited (15%)". The Empresa Metro de Bogota ABC sheet gives the same 85/15 split but names the minority holder as "Xi'an Metro Company Limited". The two city documents differ on the minority shareholder's name; both are Bogota government sources.

source.title: Los recursos de la Linea 1 estan en auditoria constante: Concesionario Metro Linea 1

discrepancies.card_says: Describes ML1 only as "Concessionaire responsible for the design, construction, operation and maintenance of Metro Line 1, per the EIB Complaints Mechanism (2025)."
discrepancies.source_says: Empresa Metro de Bogota's 2019 management report records the concession contract (No. 163 of 2019) as signed with METRO LINEA 1 S.A.S. on 27 November 2019, and describes the company as an "empresa concesionaria constituida por el APCA ganadora para la ejecucion del contrato" - i.e. formed by the winning consortium for this contract. The scope the city states also includes investment and financing, not only design, construction, operation and maintenance.

discrepancies.card_says: Lists Furnace Fabrica India Ltd as a joint-venture contractor for package TR-2/WS16, awarded 28 March 2017, with no note on the company's status.
discrepancies.source_says: The company was in corporate insolvency by the time of this card's reading: the NCLT Kochi bench admitted State Bank of India's petition against it on 1 November 2023 over a default of Rs 64,74,11,693 as on 15.05.2023, and the resolution professional's March 2024 expression of interest describes the EPC business as "non-operational for last 2 years". This does not contradict the 2017 award but a reader may take the contractor to be a going concern.

discrepancies.card_says: "a limited liability company which went bankrupt in 2015"; the report "does not say who owns the building now".
discrepancies.source_says: Kurir (6 May 2024) gives the name as "Doo Masinska industrija Nis Holding" and confirms it has been "u stecaju od 2015. godine", consistent with the card. It adds that the bankruptcy estate has continued to auction buildings in the MIN complex in Nis (a 384 sq m building offered at a starting price of 20,037,200 dinars in June 2024), after an earlier 2020 auction of MIN Holding premises reported by Danas. Separately, two Serbian Privatisation Agency notices concern differently named Nis entities - "MIN HOLDING CO ... IZGRADNJA AD" and "MIN HOLDING-CO ... MINKOMERC AD" - both joint-stock companies in bankruptcy from 2011 under Commercial Court Nis cases 2.St.91/2011 and 1.St.73/2011, so care is needed not to conflate these with the d.o.o. the card names.

No NCLT application had been admitted as at 31 March 2026.
